data.title: 椎叶紬 · 屋顶的星星
data.description: 夜色落下来后，紬靠着屋顶栏杆辨认星星。她举起画着星图的纸，把纸上的线与天空一一对照。
data.action: 她举起画着星图的纸，把纸上的线与天空一一对照
data.promptProse: On a rooftop at night, Tsumugi holds a star chart and compares its lines with the sky above the railing.
data.animaCaption: Standing beside the rooftop railing under a clear night sky, she holds up a star chart with both hands and gazes upward to match its lines with the constellations. Cool moonlight outlines her shoulders and the paper sheet.
